newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS CAUTIOUS AFTER AEX FALL.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS CAUTIOUS AFTER AEX FALL.

text.p: Dutch chartists remain
divided on the future of the AEX share index after sharp
falls last week.
Some cautiously advise buying of dips. A number see
significant resistance at around 930 points.
The AEX index ended at 894.42 points on Friday, August 15,
101.74 points below its level the previous Friday.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
JAAD - It looks like those "tight stops" really paid off.
Currently in a downward trend (or should we state: a
correction). Look for bottoms in the market. They could provide
magnificent buying opportunities."
ABN AMRO - A volatile correction has broken the short term
upward sloping trendlines. A further correction is still
possible towards 855, a 50 percent retracement level and support
from intermediate term trendlines. As long as this level holds,
the intermediate term trend is still positive. A pullback
towards the 928 breakout level becomes very likely then: for
trading purposes a significant move.
So, prices between 855 and 928 is the most likely scenario
for the time being.
GENERALE - After last week's sharp drop in prices, the AEX
is likely to recover some of the lost territory in the very
short term. Whether the market is ready to resume its way up on
a somewhat longer time frame remains to be seen.
The test of the 875 level proved that the market has found
short term support at that price level. This short term bottom
together with the presence of positive divergence on hourly
basis, provided the index with liquid upward potential.
However, there is no clear sign of strong upward potential
as long as the resistance level at 930 remains intact. We expect
prices to move towards that level and to make a serious attempt
to break above it. It is of key importance to break this
resistance in order to gain momentum and to place an attack on
the downtrend based on hourly charts, initiated at the top at
1011. The current value os this short term trend lies at 940.
On the other hand if the 930 level proves to be too strong
to break, we expect the AEX to place a renewed attack on the
recently formed support level at 875.
In case of a successful break of this short term support
level, prices of around 840 come in sight. This is based on the
longer term trend initiated in December last year.
Within the borders of this range the probabilities of the
trades is limited. Only aggressive traders are advised to play
the range. The usage of tight exit-stops is essential for profit
realisation."
ING BARINGS - Recent correction of the AEX is not the end of
the primary bull market, but just a normal interruption in the
uptrend. Money flow shows selling pressure, but does not
indicate panic selling. The advances/declines ratio is
suggesting lack of market leadership. This 10 percent correction
within the boundaries of the long term rising trend channel
indicates a buying opportunity.
All in all the technical picture of the AEX has weakened a
bit. But the longer term bull run is still intact, favouring a
scenario of buying the dips.
MEESPIERSON - An amazing fall for the index during the last
few days. For the time being we stay neutral, ahead of this
week's meetings of the German and the United States central
banks.
There is a short term resistance at 950. We think our index
won't pass this level the coming week.
